entities.name: MOM-protected phenol
observations: The substrate contains an aryl O-CH2-O-CH3 methoxymethyl (MOM) protecting group.
The product contains the corresponding free phenol after removal of the MOM fragment.

entities.name: MOM deprotection
observations: Acid-promoted cleavage of an aryl MOM ether gives the corresponding phenol without changing the aldehyde, ketone, or fused-ring skeleton.
The matched empirical reaction uses HCl, methanol, and ethyl acetate.

entities.name: HCl methanol ethyl acetate
observations: Matched reaction conditions: HCl in methanol with ethyl acetate for MOM ether deprotection.

entities.name: Trifluoroacetic acid
observations: TFA is a plausible general alternative acid for MOM deprotection, but it was not the directly matched empirical condition.

entities.name: Dilute mineral acid
observations: Dilute mineral acids are plausible general alternatives for acidic MOM deprotection, but they were not the directly matched empirical condition.
